Subject: Add-on pricing: observability retention & advanced dashboards

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is consolidating commercial terms and I need concrete numbers for the following add-ons so I can circulate them internally:

- Observability retention tiers (per month/year): 30 days, 90 days, 365 days — what are the per-seat / per-GB storage rates and any bucketed pricing?
- Tracing ingest / sampling: do you price per-trace, per-ingested-event, or as a throughput band? Any discounts for sampling and we need an idea of expected egress costs if traces are exported.
- Advanced dashboards & tracing UI: priced per seat or per-org? Is there a limit to dashboards or charts, and do you provide API access for embedding?

We have a hard procurement deadline of Feb 16 to finalize vendors. Also, please outline any volume/commit discounts you offer for annual or multi-year commitments and whether observability is billed separately from core inference usage.

If possible please include a simple table and any SOW language we should be aware of (retention guarantees, deletion windows, access to audit logs).

Best,
Emma Lawson
Sr. Procurement Manager
SentraHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 09 Feb 2026 14:20:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Add-on pricing: observability retention & advanced dashboards

Hi Emma — great to hear from you. Appreciate the timeline; we can definitely get a compact proposal over today. High-level answers first, then I attached a one-page price summary (redwood-pricing-addons-q1-2026.pdf).

Quick summary (draft, subject to final SOW):
- Observability retention tiers: 30d = $0.02/GB/month; 90d = $0.05/GB/month; 365d = $0.12/GB/month. We also offer a usage band model: up to 5TB/mo, 5-25TB/mo, 25TB+ with stepped discounts.
- Tracing: priced as throughput bands (events/sec) with a small per-Million-events add-on for heavy sampling; typical customers find the banded model easier to forecast. Export to S3/GCS has egress charges at cost (we'll estimate).
- Advanced dashboards & tracing UI: base package includes 5 seats for $1,200/month org-wide. Additional seats $200/seat/month. API embedding available via our dashboards API (rate-limited); unlimited dashboard objects up to 250 per org in base plan, extra dashboard bundles available.

Volume/commit discount example: 12-month committed contract for add-ons = up to 15% off list (tiered by spend). We can offer an additional one-time onboarding credit (covers one month of observability charges) on 12-month enterprise commitments.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm which retention tier you want for initial rollout (30/90/365).
2) Confirm expected monthly trace ingest (events/sec or GB) so we can map to a throughput band.
3) I’ll route an internal approval for a formal discount and SOW language and return a DocuSign.

Attachment: redwood-pricing-addons-q1-2026.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Thanks — I can hop on a 20-min call if you prefer to run through numbers before procurement.

—
